p: fixed: This earnest affection declares that he is free from hypocrisy and that sluggishness does not stop him.
people: He prophecies of the calling of the Gentiles: for unless they were called, they could not hear the goodness of God.
Be thou exalted: Let all the world see your judgments in that you are God over all, and so confess that you are glorious.
save with thy right hand: When God by his benefits makes us partakers of his mercies, he admonishes us to be earnest in prayer, to desire him to continue and finish his graces.
holiness: As he has spoken to Samuel concerning me, so will he show himself constant and holy in his promise, so that these nations following will be subject to me.
Wilt not thou: From the sixth verse of this psalm to the last, read also Ps 60:5.
